race.description: Country Cups Challenge Qualifier Quality Open Hcp
race.comment: DEFERENTIAL (9) is a clear danger, having won well at Richmond Qld before a close second at Charleville despite beginning slowly and racing wide. GREEN SHADOWS (2) can improve sharply back to this trip after a slow-start seventh over 1100m at this track, especially with the Longreach win over TESTATOR SILENS LITTLE COINTREAU still relevant. TESTATOR SILENS (1) resumes from a two-month break after a poor Emerald run, but his prior Longreach second and proven mile record keep him in the race if he returns near that level. LITTLE COINTREAU (8) is knocking on the door and is drawn to advantage at a track he races well at. Can play a major role.
